data.name: Imamul
data.gender_notes: Imamul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of. The name Imamul carries the meaning “God's servant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Imamul usually hope their child will grow to embody god's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Serving and surrendering to the divine will.
data.etymology: Imamul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imamul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
